description: Use this when you need to know whether a scheduled US release (CPI, PPI, payrolls, JOLTS, GDP, PCE, FOMC, retail sales, claims) or an S&P 100/NASDAQ-100 earnings 8-K is out, when it was first seen, and actual vs prior vs revision. event.description: Comma-separated event types: cpi, ppi, employment_situation, jolts, eci, gdp, pce, retail_sales, jobless_claims, fomc_decision, fomc_minutes, ism_manufacturing, ism_services, trade_balance, productivity

from.description: Start date (ET) YYYY-MM-DD, default 7 days ago.

ticker.description: S&P 100 / NASDAQ-100 ticker: adds its latest 8-K Item 2.02 (earnings) acceptance time.

to.description: End date (ET) YYYY-MM-DD, default 2 days ahead.
